name: DNA Double Helix
semanticDescription: High-fidelity 3D model of the B-DNA double helix with dual presentation collections: DNA_Full (antiparallel double helix with 3.4 nm pitch, 10 bp/turn, alternating major/minor grooves, Watson-Crick paired rungs, 5' and 3' direction tags, and laboratory exhibition stand) and DNA_Detail (high-resolution unzipped nucleotide subunit architecture per NCERT Class 12 Fig 6.2 showing pentose deoxyribose rings, phosphate groups with phosphodiester bonds, purine double-rings, pyrimidine single-rings, and stoichiometric 2 vs 3 hydrogen bonds).
simplifications: Atomic coordinates stylized into molecular subunit visualization scale with authentic major and minor groove dimensions.
Stoichiometric hydrogen bonds represented as illuminated dotted interfaces (2 for A=T, 3 for G≡C).
